'''Straight and Steady''' is the 6th virtual expansion of [[Star Trek CCG 1st Edition]]. It is published by [[The Continuing Committee]] on 22 October 2010. The set consists of 57 cards. This set is part of the ''Life From Lifelessness block'' consisting of cards from [[Life From Lifelessness (expansion)|Life From Lifelessness]], [[Straight and Steady (expansion)|Straight and Steady]], [[BaH! (expansion)|BaH!]], [[Shades of Gray (expansion)|Shades of Gray]], and [[Resistance Is Futile (expansion)|Resistance Is Futile]] virtual expansions.

*4 [[:Category:Ship (Star Trek CCG 1E)|Ship]] (2 Klingon, 2 Non-Aligned, 1 Romulan and 1 Starfleet)
*3 [[:Category:Time Location (Star Trek CCG 1E)|Time Location]]
